description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'AuthProviderChainTest' that tests the functionality of the 'AuthProviderChain' class and its interaction with various mock authentication providers within the OrangeHRM project. It verifies provider addition, priority conflicts, and the authentication process with multiple providers.

classes.name: AuthProviderChainTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the authentication provider chain logic including adding providers, precedence, conflict handling, and authentication resolution.

classes.name: DebugAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock authentication provider with configurable priority, always returns true for authentication.

classes.name: LocalAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock authentication provider with configurable priority, authenticates if username equals password and username is not null.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock LDAP authentication provider with configurable priority, authenticates if username equals password and username is not null.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithOneProvider
methods.description: Tests authentication with a single provider in the chain.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingFirstProvider
methods.description: Tests chain logic when the first provider successfully authenticates.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingSecondProvider
methods.description: Tests chain logic when the second provider successfully authenticates.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingLastProvider
methods.description: Tests chain logic when the last provider successfully authenticates.

methods.name: testAddProviderWithMultipleProvidersWithSamePriority
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown when adding providers with conflicting priorities.

methods.name: testAddProvider
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown if the same provider instance is added more than once.
